svg.text: Agent selects from these each iteration
Filter by home/away, W/L, clutch, date range
Top-N league leaders for any stat & season
User types query → browser sends POST /api/query to Flask, receives job_id
Flask spawns a background NBAStatsAgent thread; browser opens SSE connection
Agent calls Gemini 2.5 Flash → LLM reasons and decides which tool to invoke next
Agent calls tool (e.g. get_career_stats) → Tool fetches from stats.nba.com → returns result to Agent
Agent repeats steps 3–4 up to 12× until enough data is collected (Think → Act → Observe loop)
bbref_client provides fallback for 2025-26 season data and current leaderboards
Agent merges all tool results via _merge_raw_logs(), Gemini generates a final narrative
Flask streams SSE events → browser renders career cards, highs, accolades & charts
User reads response in natural language; can ask follow-up queries to restart the loop
